dialect_varying_payloads.reason: OpenInference records an LLM span's whole request envelope in input.value (messages plus model, tool definitions and invocation parameters) and the whole provider response in output.value; OTel GenAI records the normalized conversation in gen_ai.input.messages / gen_ai.output.messages. One strictly contains the other plus more, so neither is a re-encoding of the other and SPEC.md 3.3 constrains neither (FIXTURES.md 4.4). The agent span differs the same way: a bare string against the same text inside the message array. `mime` is declared wherever a payload is, and on the tool span it is declared ALONE: OTel GenAI states no content type anywhere in the dialect, while the tool payload VALUES agree byte-for-byte between the two captured traces -- so the value stays compared, because that agreement is the strongest cross-dialect evidence the corpus has.
